name: number_partitioning_k5_n14_seed43445__v8_nh
prompt:
Partition the integers {1, 2, ..., 14} into 5 disjoint subsets, each summing to the same value 21. (The total sum is 14*(14+1)/2 = 105, so the target is 105/5 = 21.) NP-hard partition problem.

Return a flat list of 14 integers in {0, ..., 4} where the i-th entry (0-indexed) gives the subset assignment of integer i+1. State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such partition exists.
